thesisIntroduction.title: Master's Thesis Introduction
thesisIntroduction.content: AthletiX is an innovative training and nutrition management platform that aims to revolutionize the way fitness professionals collaborate with their clients and how companies manage their sports services.

problemStatement.title: Problem Identification
problemStatement.content: The modern fitness industry faces numerous technological and organizational challenges that hinder effective collaboration between trainers and clients, as well as efficient management of fitness services.
features: Lack of integrated systems for managing training and nutrition plans
Difficulties in real-time client progress monitoring
Communication problems between professionals and clients
Ineffective management of fitness companies and their staff
Absence of tools for managing multiple user roles in one system

objectives.title: Project Objectives
objectives.content: The main goal of this thesis is to create a comprehensive digital platform that integrates all aspects of fitness service management into one intuitive system.
features: Development of multi-role user management system (clients, professionals, administrators)
Implementation of fitness company management system with permission hierarchy
Creation of tools for developing and managing training and nutrition plans
Design of progress monitoring and communication system
Implementation of modern web technologies for optimal performance

scope.title: Project Scope
scope.content: The AthletiX platform encompasses a comprehensive digital ecosystem for the fitness industry, built using modern web technologies and security best practices.
features: Frontend: React 19 with Next.js 15 and TypeScript for type safety
Backend: Next.js API Routes with MongoDB as database
Authorization: NextAuth.js v5 with advanced role system
Styling: Tailwind CSS with dark mode support
Testing: Vitest with comprehensive test coverage
Deployment: Optimized production build with scaling support

technicalInnovation.title: Technical Innovations
technicalInnovation.content: The platform utilizes cutting-edge technologies and design patterns to ensure high performance, security, and ease of development.
features: Full-stack architecture based on Next.js with App Router
State management system with React Hooks and Context API
Advanced authorization system with multiple roles and contexts
MongoDB with Mongoose ODM for flexible data management
Stripe integration for payment and subscription system
Modular component architecture with TypeScript interfaces

expectedOutcomes.title: Expected Results
expectedOutcomes.content: The implementation of the AthletiX project aims to deliver a platform that significantly improves the fitness industry through digitization and automation of key processes.
features: Increase personal trainer efficiency by at least 40%
Streamline fitness company and resource management
Reduce time needed for administrative tasks
Create a scalable platform ready for international expansion
Establish new standards in fitness industry digitization
